selectionRule.selectionBasis: Exposed engineering tie at H50/H70; shortest chosen explicitly by user. Previous failed result unchanged. No new width search or fallback.
selectionRule.warmReady: Exactly once per source session, after publication of first completely analyzed 600ms owned interval. Startup observations are discarded. Initial inputEligibleAfter is that exact source owned-end boundary, computed only from chronology; not from decoded events or truth.
selectionRule.rearm: After each generic sealed attempt/instant downstream verdict, sample independently advancing physical capture/source clock. Retire all event times <= capturedThrough. Never use analysis frontier or publication arrival as event time.
selectionRule.geometry: First eligible source event T, fixed [T,T+50ms), no extension or target access, seal only after analyzed frontier covers end, no attempt queue.
selectionRule.sourceOrder: lexical recordingId then earliest MIDI occurrence; exclude every source ID/audio SHA/MIDI SHA in previous STEP decoded development and fresh-strike development manifests
selectionRule.positiveIsolation: Ordinary intended groups: previous any-pitch note-on group >=350ms earlier, next any-pitch group >=1200ms later. No other note-ons after warm source boundary and before intended group. Real preroll >=1200ms; full 2400ms owned region; target 950ms into region (warm boundary 350ms before target); genuine 200ms tail. No output-dependent selection.
selectionRule.rapidIsolation: Rapid retrigger uses previous same-pitch physical group at 200..250ms and no intervening group; next group >=1200ms later. Warm source boundary is midpoint between context group last note-on and intended group first note-on. Previous context is startup-ineligible. Record if actual evidence availability makes intended physical opportunity precede semantic READY; such a trial cannot be advertised as a valid waiting-user acceptance.
selectionRule.negativeIsolation: Any-pitch note-on-free held/pedal guard >=1800ms, selected from MIDI independently. Warm source boundary = guard.start+200ms; scored negative duration =1200ms; genuine prior context/tail. Held case uses a single-pitch preceding group, pedal case a multi-pitch preceding group, to exercise both sustain categories.
selectionRule.metadataTags: Reuse frozen first-anchor <=35ms MIDI truth grouping only. close-spread: >=2 distinct pitches and 0<note-on spread<=35ms. Repeated/soft/rapid tags from MIDI history; no audio/model output inspected. Busy/late select earliest primary opportunity with previous note-on group >=350ms earlier, exactly one next group at 600..900ms, then >=1200ms before another group. Stage B tests a predeclared 1000ms post-seal analysis hold while physical capture continues; late replay preserves original event identities/times. This delay is a state-machine challenge, not assembly width or measured UX latency.
selectionRule.counterfactualsAfterSealOnly: Physical set P yields P, remove highest pitch, add lowest absent piano pitch, replace highest with nearest absent semitone, replace highest with nearest absent octave; same-target sentinels permit detecting any unsupported later advance. No expected target enters Stage A.
selectionRule.truthMatch: One-to-one exact physical pitch-set match within inclusive 100ms; maximize cardinality then minimize absolute timing error. All seven architecture invariants and six empirical false-MATCH categories reported separately. Do not infer empirical zero from architecture assertions.
selectionRule.clockScope: Deterministic continuously advancing source-sample playback simulation plus measured real Worker transaction durations, not device latency. Availability schedules transactions, never defines physical anchor. Timing-invalid waiting trials are disclosed as harness/corpus limitations, not silently replaced.
selectionRule.holdout: Existing local SMD paired recordings, engineering only, not globally blind due earlier AMT/Continuous exposure. No new external data. Missing family blocks; no replacement after output.
